# Custom Instructions for hand-teleop-system Project

## Project Context
This is the hand-teleop-system project, focused on hand teleoperation systems.

## Conda Environment
- Always use the Conda environment named `hand-teleop`.
- To activate the environment, run: `conda activate hand-teleop`.
- Ensure all Python scripts are executed within this environment.

## Python Execution
- Use `python3` instead of `python` for running scripts.
- For development, run scripts with the `--dev` flag, e.g., `python3 main.py --dev`.
- Ensure all Python commands are executed with `python3`, e.g., `python3 script.py` instead of `python script.py`.

## Coding Guidelines
- Follow standard Python PEP 8 style guidelines.
- Use relative imports within the project where applicable.
- Include docstrings for all functions and classes.
